name: Nomsa M.
message_en: Compassionate and professional from start to finish. We felt truly supported.
message_zu: Babenozwelo futhi benobungcweti kusukela ekuqaleni kuze kube sekugcineni. Sazizwa sisekelwe ngempela.

message_en: They handled details we didn't even think about. Thank you for the dignity and care.
message_zu: Banakekela nemininingwane esasingayicabanganga. Siyabonga ngesithunzi nangokunakekela.

name: The Dlamini Family
message_en: Professional service and warm guidance through a difficult week.
message_zu: Insizakalo yobungcweti nesiqondiso esifudumele phakathi nesonto elinzima.
